newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Alex. Brown ups Costco.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Alex. Brown ups Costco.

text.p: -- Alex. Brown analyst Barbara Miller said she upgraded Costco Cos Inc to a strong buy from a buy rating.
-- said upgrade based on anticipation of strong earnings for second quarter ended February 1997.
-- estimates second quarter earnings of $0.45 a share, compared to $0.35 a share the previous second quarter and a First Call estimate of $0.43.
-- said sees sustainable strength in sales and margins.
-- raised 1997 earnings estimate to $1.56 a share from $1.51, compared to $1.22 a share earned in 1996.
-- raised 1998 earnings estimate to $1.83 a share from $1.76.
-- set price target of $34 in six to 12 months.
-- Costco stock traded up 1-1/16 to 28-5/8 in morning trade.
